title: Norovirus Caused 83% Of Cruise Outbreaks
hook: One illness caused 83% of cruise outbreaks.
closing: On crowded ships, basic handwashing protects more people than it seems.
question: Would an outbreak change your cruise?

segments.say: Cruise outbreaks reached 20 in a year. The recent climb makes prevention harder to ignore.
Norovirus caused 83% of cruise outbreaks. One contagious illness drives most of the problem.
The largest cruise ship holds 7,600 guests. One outbreak can reach a floating city.
